feed.subtitle: Cambios en el catálogo CISA KEV

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133469 · Vates Xen Orchestra
entry.summary: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133324 · Mitel MiCollab
entry.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133323 · Mitel MiCollab
entry.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133311 · Mitel MiCollab
entry.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133303 · Mitel MiCollab
entry.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133275 · Mitel MiCollab
entry.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2025-41450 · Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
entry.summary: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2023-25915 · Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
entry.summary: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2023-25914 · Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
entry.summary: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-103406 · Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
entry.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-132224 · Optimizely Web Experimentation
entry.summary: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websi

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-132165 · Drupal Core
entry.summary: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-131914 · Idunno AntiCsrf
entry.summary: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

entry.title: Modificada: CVE-2024-10441 · Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)
entry.summary: Cambios: uso en ransomware

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-134624 · N-able MailAssure
entry.summary: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-133968 · Project MONAI MONAI Label
entry.summary: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-76466 · Cisco Expressway Series
entry.summary: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-129448 · Apache Roller
entry.summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-123890 · Broadcom VMware vCenter
entry.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2025-42884 · SAP NetWeaver
entry.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-90817 · Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
entry.summary: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing

entry.summary: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-40217 · BerriAI LiteLLM
entry.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2024-10441 · Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)
entry.summary: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-115731 · Perforce Puppet Enterprise
entry.summary: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. entry.summary: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-114713 · UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd
entry.summary: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd contains an improper neutralization of delimiters vulnerability that allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-20320 · Cisco BroadWorks
entry.summary: Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-125350 · Google Chromium
entry.summary: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-124194 · Microsoft Office
entry.summary: Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-116606 · Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG)
entry.summary: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-111793 · Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder
entry.summary: Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

entry.summary: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-123218 · IBM Aspera Faspex
entry.summary: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-123158 · OpenBSD OpenSSH
entry.summary: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-116779 · SignalWire FreeSwitch
entry.summary: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-102895 · GPUStack GPUStack
entry.summary: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-19868 · SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN
entry.summary: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2024-27834 · Apple Multiple Products
entry.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-119977 · WordPress WordPress Core
entry.summary: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-118527 · Ivanti Connect Secure
entry.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-111357 · Ivanti Connect Secure
entry.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-97229 · GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
entry.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-76418 · Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
entry.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-46300 · Linux Kernel
entry.summary: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-41709 · Broadcom VMware ESX
entry.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-48356 · Adobe Commerce and Magento
entry.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-111497 · Google Brotli
entry.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-109619 · PHP Group PHP
entry.summary: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

entry.title: Nueva en KEV: CVE-2026-109618 · PHP Group PHP
entry.summary: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.
